segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Pip!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you shout over the wailing sirens.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: They're on both sides of the bridge! What do we do?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip stood up, dusted off his lapels, and adjusted his crooked detective cap with absolute, unshakable swagger.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Do not fret, young colleague!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip announced in his finest, most aristocratic British cadence.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Master Detective Pip has already calculated our optimal vectors! I have conceived a one-hundred-percent foolproof, mathematically flawless tactical extraction!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: What extraction?!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Behold!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip declared, pointing dramatically toward the canyon rim.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Just beyond this ledge lies a battered old cargo sled! We shall execute a synchronized, acrobatic leap, engage the steering runners for controlled deceleration, and gracefully—

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip took a grand, heroic step forward.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His hind boot planted squarely on the trailing fringe of his four-foot red knit scarf.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip's eyes bulged out of his furry head.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: OH GINGER-SNAPS—

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip’s paws windmilled in the air. In a blind panic, he lunged forward, grabbed you by the front of your jacket, and you both tumbled over the ledge, crashing directly onto the battered wooden cargo sled!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: KER-SLAM!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The rusty iron runners broke free from the ice with a loud CRACK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The sled shot down the steep wooden timber flume like a rocket!

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: GRAB THE ROPES!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you scream.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You grab the frozen steering ropes with both mittens, desperately trying to keep the sled from spinning off the edge.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip didn't land in the seat. He tumbled head-first into the curved front nose of the toboggan! His green coat bunched up around his ears, his little hind boots kicked frantically in the air, and his ENORMOUS, bushy, fluffy fox tail bounced violently right in front of your face!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: FLUMP-FLUMP-FLUMP!

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: I CAN'T SEE!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you yell, spitting red fox fur out of your mouth.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: PIP! YOUR TAIL IS IN MY EYES!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: From somewhere deep inside the front curve of the sled, a muffled, high-pitched squeak echoed back:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: WE’RE GOING THREE HUNDRED MILES AN HOUR! I CAN'T HEAR YOU OVER THE SOUND OF MY ENTIRE LIFE FLASHING BEFORE MY EYES! SAVE MY HAT!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SWOOOOOOOOOSH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The sled hit an icy seventy-degree bank, kicking up a blinding wall of glittering snow crystals! Searchlight beams whipped overhead through the dark pine canopy! You lean hard to the left, peering around Pip's wildly twitching tail just in time to see a frozen waterfall rushing toward you!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You yank the right rope with all your strength.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The sled airborne—twenty feet through the air in a blur of red scarf, flying snow, and screaming fox—before burying itself directly into a thirty-foot mountain of powdery snow right at the foot of an enormous, frozen waterwheel!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: KER-BLAM!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A mushroom cloud of white powder exploded into the night.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then... complete, dead silence.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Snowflakes gently drifted down from the frosted wooden eaves of the old mill.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The wooden toboggan was wedged nose-down in the drift. Pip’s hind legs stopped kicking, slowly sank into the snow, and then popped out again like two furry twigs.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With a loud SHWUCK, Pip yanked his head out of the snowdrift. His green coat was stuffed with snow, his ears were drooping, and his houndstooth cap was pulled down over his nose.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He spit out a mouthful of snow, cleared his throat, and looked at you with supreme, unbothered dignity:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Ahem. Flawless execution. A masterclass in gravimetric evasion.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He pulled his cap up and brushed his whiskers.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You may applaud now.
